hypothesis: Remaining unexplained work may arise from sampling-parameter branches. Counting stochastic requests alongside initialization, batch size, and text volume should capture this independent source of variation.

pcvs.name: default_tokenization

pcvs.name: request_count
pcvs.rationale: Tracks common rendering and engine-insertion work per request.

pcvs.name: total_prompt_characters
pcvs.rationale: Measures batch text volume without consuming the rendering generator.

pcvs.name: sampled_requests
pcvs.rationale: Counts requests using stochastic sampling, which require different sampling-parameter validation and preparation from greedy requests.
